articles.title: India’s PM Winds Up Visit to Indonesia, Hails ‘New Avenues’ For Cooperation
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded a three-day visit to Indonesia, strengthening bilateral ties. Significant agreements were signed, notably concerning critical minerals, agriculture, and missile procurements. These deals underscore India's deepening strategic partnership with Indonesia and its commitment to enhancing regional security and economic cooperation in Southeast Asia, vital for India's Act East policy and strategic autonomy.
